results.title: Nigerian Court Jails Chinese National, Others Over Terrorism | Naija News
results.snippet:
The court heard that the defendants, including Liu, were intercepted along Yauri Road while travelling in a vehicle allegedly acquired to transport kidnapped victims to a forest hideout.

Liu was reportedly arrested with a Beretta pistol and convicted in connection with the offences.

Aliyu Hadari and Umar Musa Uzzi were each sentenced to 15 years’ imprisonment, while Liu received six years. [...]
